# GetMedia

> GetMedia is a free, open-source Windows desktop app to download videos and audio from YouTube and other sites, powered by yt-dlp and ffmpeg.

## Official links

- [Website](https://getmedia-app.vercel.app): GetMedia official homepage
- [Website in English](https://getmedia-app.vercel.app/en): English version of the website
- [Website in Portuguese](https://getmedia-app.vercel.app/pt-BR): Brazilian Portuguese version of the website
- [Website in Spanish](https://getmedia-app.vercel.app/es): Spanish version of the website
- [Latest release (.exe download)](https://github.com/ThiagoHDMiranda/GetMedia_Desktop/releases/latest): download the Windows installer
- [GetMedia_Desktop repository](https://github.com/ThiagoHDMiranda/GetMedia_Desktop): source code of the desktop app
- [Author on GitHub](https://github.com/ThiagoHDMiranda): Thiago Miranda's GitHub profile

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows only (installer is a single .exe)
- License: MIT
- Download libs: [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) and [ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org)
- Supports YouTube and other sites supported by yt-dlp
